body.p: The father of a man named Apalok killed a bear; and a Raven which was near thought, "Shall I not try to eat the blood by putting my head into the wound?" But while the Raven's head was in the wound, the hunter came up and killed the Raven by twisting its neck. The Raven, while dying, cried, "I am taken by the neck in the hole [wound]! Oh, where is the light now? My dear little children! I think of them only. They are wandering about unfledged, unprotected from the cold. "O Aimakta, Nuimakta, Atsenaktok, Tokoyatok, Ovayok, Makkongayok, Akpayok!"[[These are the names of the children.]]
